# Bitsmasher Lab & Infrastructure
> Documentation and manual for bitsmasher homelab, networking, and automation.

## Core Infrastructure
- Website: https://www.bitsmasher.net
- DNS: node3 (10.10.12.3) — authoritative BIND9 master for lab.bitsmasher.net
- KDC: odroid-c1.lab.bitsmasher.net — MIT Kerberos KDC for lab.bitsmasher.net realm
- Ansible workspace: stargate.research.bitsmasher.net (primary), chonk.local (secondary mirror)

## Manual & Documentation
- [Lab Manual Markdown](https://www.bitsmasher.net/manual/manual.md): Full comprehensive lab documentation in plain markdown.
- [Lab Manual JSON Index](https://www.bitsmasher.net/manual/index.json): Section index with page ranges and section slugs.
- [Lab Manual PDF](https://www.bitsmasher.net/manual/lab-manual.pdf): Print-ready 62-page lab manual.
- [Manual HTML](https://www.bitsmasher.net/manual/): Browser-readable manual landing page with JSON-LD Schema.org markup.


## Nostr Identity & Talks
- [/nostr/index.html](/nostr/index.html): Personal Nostr public keys and protocol presentations
- [/nostr/index.json](/nostr/index.json): JSON Feed manifest of Nostr decks and assets
- [/nostr/slides/codemash/codemash-nostr.pdf](/nostr/slides/codemash/codemash-nostr.pdf): CodeMash presentation deck
- [/nostr/slides/bsides-cosprings/bsides-nostr-security.pdf](/nostr/slides/bsides-cosprings/bsides-nostr-security.pdf): BSides Colorado Springs security presentation deck
## Training & Curriculum
- [Training Index](https://www.bitsmasher.net/training/): Technical training curriculum and slide decks.
- [Coding Foundations](https://www.bitsmasher.net/training/docs/coding-foundations.html): Systems and software engineering syllabus.
- [AI Security](https://www.bitsmasher.net/training/docs/ai-security.html): Enterprise AI security, threat modeling, defensive operations.

## Research
- [Research Index](https://www.bitsmasher.net/research/): Systems and security engineering research blog.
- [Research About](https://www.bitsmasher.net/research/about/): Research methodology overview.

## Discovery & Metadata
- [robots.txt](https://www.bitsmasher.net/robots.txt): Crawling rules for search engines.
- [sitemap.xml](https://www.bitsmasher.net/sitemap.xml): XML site map covering all routes.
- [llms-full.txt](https://www.bitsmasher.net/llms-full.txt): Complete concatenated documentation archive.
- [nostr.txt](https://www.bitsmasher.net/nostr.txt): Nostr-related metadata and protocol docs.
